items.title: Health Care Roundup: Market Talk
items.summary: 1655 GMT – Eli Lilly CEO  David Ricks  says on CNBC that Foundayo—the company’s recently launched once-daily GLP-1 pill—is expanding the market, not cannibalizing it even though it’s offered at lower prices.  At the same time, access to weight-loss treatments continues to expand, further increasing the total addressable market, Ricks says.  Eli Lilly is up 3%.
